title: Fuel a Future:
title_short: Fuel a Future · Campaign launch reel
headline: Launch the Fuel a Future campaign with one idea: talent is everywhere, opportunity is not, and NFTE gives young people the skills and the belief to build their future.
story: Winners on stage, and the line JD quotes: talent is universal, opportunity is not.
Young people want purpose, not theory. NFTE gives them the skills school doesn't. And now NFTE is merging and partnering with others, like BUILD, to make this bigger.
It doesn't take much to get over a lot of disadvantages and do something really special.
do: Open on winners celebrating with the hook text.
Students and audience on screen under every JD line.
Put the NFTE + BUILD line in the middle with BUILD students on screen.
Cut fast; keep the strongest 2 to 3 middle bites if tight.
End on the strongest single student moment.
dont: No city on screen or in captions.
Don't credit the talent line to JD on screen (he quotes it).
No JD self-intro, no NFTE history.
